definitions.explanation: The quality of being efficient; the ratio of output to input in a process.

⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効率性|こうりつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げたい→上げる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve work efficiency.

examples.english: In the excessive pursuit of efficiency, the burden on employees has grown.

notes:
{効率性|こうりつせい} refers to the quality or degree of efficiency — how well resources (time, money, effort) are used to achieve results.

FORMS:
⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ (efficiency) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality/nature). The ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ suffix creates abstract quality nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効率性|こうりつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve efficiency
- {効率性|こうりつせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to prioritize efficiency
- {効率性|こうりつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement of efficiency
- {効率性|こうりつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: efficiency is low

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {効率性|こうりつせい}: efficiency as a quality (abstract)
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧: efficiency (more general, concrete)
- ⟦{生産性|せいさんせい}→生産性：05574_seisansei⟧: productivity
- ⟦{能率|のうりつ}→能率：04298_nouritsu⟧: work efficiency, productivity

USAGE:
⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ alone is more common in everyday speech; {効率性|こうりつせい} appears more in formal/academic writing.
